Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

Document/reducer/undo, immutable revisions, codecs, project bundle, atomic store, journal/recovery, retention and freshness are implemented. ProjectSession explicitly controls writer locks, serialized operations and recovery decisions. The original S2.5 repair and S2.9 lifecycle UI children remain to be reconciled; lower-level save/recovery success alone does not prove the complete user-facing lifecycle.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/session/ProjectSession.scala:90
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/platform/FileProjectStore.scala:74
- studio/core/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/session/RecoveryFaultSuite.scala:1

Remaining / next action: Finish remaining repair/lifecycle acceptance and verify open/new/save/save-as/recent/dirty-close/recovery flows through the actual host; keep store retention and exported lock-file follow-ups separate.

Disposition: Keep open.
